tier_def: 0 buffer-flagged & still cleared, 1 buffer-flagged, 2 near-drain & still cleared, 3 near-drain, 4 other; ranked by tier then footprint; flags are 'possible, verify on ground' (10 m px vs 3-30 m buffers; drain 50 m is proximity context, not an encroachment call)
confidence_def: share of post-t0 observed dates (c1,t1,c2; clear pixels only) at which the site is not vegetation
status_def: completed: built at t1; active: stage advanced across observed dates; stalled: cleared at first observed date and still bare; reverted_or_seasonal: vegetation again at last date
note: stages at 10 m from indices (veg NDVI>=0.35; built NDBI>0 & BSI<0.15); c2 is a later, possibly monsoon, scene
